9dec14a6.text:
Some good whitestone oak - Before it was taken over, the mines below Moonbrook in Westfall had an abundance of the lumber; they used it in the construction of some of their more important lattices and tools because of its resilience to heat and pressure.

It was brought down there after being shipped from overseas somewhere. It's a rare wood that is plenty strong enough to be used in the crafting of your weapon. If any of it's left in the mines, then the goblin woodcarvers would have it.
9dec14a6.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

bba92815.text:
DANSTAR,
Before I go any further, let me thank you again for everything you've done for my wife and I. You saved her life, and for that, I owe you far more than I could possibly repay in a hundred lives. She is everything to me. If she would have died... well, I don't know what I would have done.

Here is the list of things you'll need to recover if I am going to forge a holy weapon for you. I put them in order of what I thought was easiest to hardest--I hope that makes it simpler for you.
bba92815.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

10276|2024fca2.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|2024fca2.text: The life of a smith is not an easy one, but it puts steel in yer bones and fire in yer heart. My da' was a smith, my grandfather before him in the forges beneath Grim Batol. And now my son follows in our footsteps, that boy makes me proud.

10277|a7662787.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|a7662787.text: Eh? I don't have time ta chat, my da' wants me ta finish this order fer him.

1077|75241b9c.name: Prospector Whelgar
1077|75241b9c.text: Oh my, this is quite historical.  A monumental find.  But these wretched beasts!  Merrin seems to be handling the situation quite well.  Now if I could just piece together this complicated puzzle. . . .

11040|c50ede3b.name: Watcher Brownell
11040|c50ede3b.text:
Have you seen Watcher Backus? So brave...

I think he's the toughest of all the Night Watch. I wonder if he even notices I'm around....

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

2086|4eb20e0f.name: Valstag Ironjaw
2086|4eb20e0f.text: It takes strong arms and brave hearts to keep the town of Menethil safe!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

274781|21c84810.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|21c84810.text: Where is the Auction House?  Why it's right by the gates of Ironforge as you enter our fine city.  Ye'll find it just across from The Vault.

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

3181|a28d29e1.name: Fremal Doohickey
3181|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

4981|ed056522.name: Ben Trias
4981|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

5148|2583dfa7.name: Beldruk Doombrow
5148|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

5164|fe2e6e4c.name: Grumnus Steelshaper
5164|fe2e6e4c.text: What can I do for ye?

5193|e9a7b43b.name: Rebecca Laughlin
5193|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5595|034389cd.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|034389cd.text: Brandur Ironhammer would be the one ye'd want to see.  Ye can find him in the Hall of Mysteries north of the gates of Ironforge.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ab5dd850.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7766|2849f8e9.name: Tyrion
7766|2849f8e9.text:
You'll have to be patient with me, $N. I've got my Spybot inside working on a very delicate matter. I'll be with ya in a second.

Oh, and do me a favor, try not to let Lescovar see you... we're about to ambush him.

7766|e0ee2668.name: Tyrion
7766|e0ee2668.text: Oh, if I only had a tree branch to hold up in front of me. The guards would never see me then.

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1442-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
1442-accept.text:
Greetings, $N. What can I do for one who follows a holy path?

Ah, yes, Stilwell, the blacksmith... from long ago. I remember him well, though, I have not heard his name in some time.

He never struck me as an impudent man, so I can only assume his desire for a Kor gem is noble.

If you truly wish for one of the gems, then you must head to the northwest of Ashenvale. You will find Blackfathom Deeps there within some ancient ruins. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, $c.
1442-accept.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

1442-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
1442-complete.text:
This is indeed the gem Stilwell desires, but before I can allow you to bring it to him, it must be purified of corruption--the naga wenches imbue the gems with power, that much is true, but of their own, evil kind.

Let Stilwell know that its power is intact, and it should work well for whatever ritual he wishes it to be part of.

I hope you know what you're doing, $c, this is no simple item you possess.
1442-complete.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

1442-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
1442-progress.text: I would be less trustful of one not on a holy path if they came asking about a Kor gem. But I trust your kind more than some of my kin. I do not judge your entire order based on the actions of just one of your fallen kind.
1442-progress.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

275-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-accept.text:
I do not know why, but a festering grows within the Wetlands. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.

The Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the Wetlands.
275-accept.title: Blisters on the Land

275-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-complete.text: This land is soothed by your efforts, and for this I will grant you a boon.
275-complete.title: Blisters on the Land

286-accept.name: Unknown
286-accept.text:
After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw.  It depicts a young, long-haired $C with hammer upraised.

This must be the Menethil Statuette!  You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
286-accept.title: Return the Statuette

78146-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78146-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78146-complete.title: Goaz Scrolls

78146-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78146-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78146-progress.title: Goaz Scrolls

79363-accept.name: Unknown
79363-accept.text:
A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.

With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.
79363-accept.title: Silvia's Sword

79363-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
79363-complete.text:
Silvia Valor, hmm? Ah, yes. A fine warrior and a defender of our way of life--albeit with a narrow vision of what that was.

Your guess is as good as mine what she would want, but the defias was a good start. Let me study this blade further.
79363-complete.title: Silvia's Sword

79363-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
79363-progress.text: You look like you've seen a ghost!
79363-progress.title: Silvia's Sword

95646-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-accept.text:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646-accept.title: Horrors in the Highland

95646-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-complete.text: It is worse than I feared. An ancient energy stirs. It would be most wise for you to carry word to your eager excavators to stop digging, for their own safety.
95646-complete.title: Horrors in the Highland

95646-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-progress.text: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646-progress.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647-complete.name: Unknown
95647-complete.text: I thought we were done for! Something upset the wildlife around here and our excavation team was overwhelmed. Thank you for helping us with those spiders.
95647-complete.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95772-complete.name: Unknown
95772-complete.text: This dwarf bears a striking resemblance to Dorin Songblade. The gun in his hands has the letters "DLS" carved into the stock.
95772-complete.title: Songblade Search

95810-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
95810-complete.text:
Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there. 

Well, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.
95810-complete.title: Lost Relic Carry

98208-complete.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-complete.text:
It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!

A thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...
98208-complete.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98208-progress.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-accept.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98209-accept.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209-accept.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-complete.text:
The Nord'el survived? It cannot be... after all these years!

Our goddess is most wonderful indeed!

You have my thanks for delivering it here. It is a rare light in the dark times we have had of late, and a symbol of not only Elune's grace, but of the enduring will of our people to persevere without our immortality.

I will see to it that it is transported safely to Darnassus, so that it may be properly cultivated.
98209-complete.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-progress.text: I welcome you to Auberdine, $c. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?
98209-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98216-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
98216-complete.text:
Look there--see how the Goaz Stone starts to glow when near the keystone? I can almost make out some more words...

We still must learn more about this Goaz. I feel like we're just on the tip of the iceberg with something huge!
98216-complete.title: Understanding Our Present

98221-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98221-complete.text:
Ironforge as well? Nek'rosh certainly has his father's ambition!

What he lacks, of course, is the enslaved army of red drakes that proved so devastating in the war. He's made a gambit, alright--one he will pay for dearly.
98221-complete.title: From the Ashes

98223-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98223-complete.text:
It's best we destroy this. Useful or not, we're not in the business of taking chances with any of those foul orcs.

The last thing we need are dragonriders on our doorstep!

And this Shadow Council business... most troubling. I'll send word to my superiors at once.
98223-complete.title: Old Habits

98223-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98223-progress.text: I can practically hear the cries of the Dragonmaw from here! They deserve every bit of it and more.
98223-progress.title: Old Habits

98230-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98230-complete.text: If yer here to help, I won't say no. Help's awful hard to come by these days.
98230-complete.title: This Land Was Their Land

98245-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-complete.text: These'll make a beautiful set of awls. Thank ye.
98245-complete.title: Razormaw Needling

98245-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-progress.text: Any luck prying those teeth off? I need 'em whole so they don't snap on the scales right away.
98245-progress.title: Razormaw Needling

98246-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-complete.text:
They're not for me plan--they're to feed Bassbeak. She's of no help at all if she's hungry, trust me. She might be more dangerous than the orcs if she's ticked off!

Untainted food can be hard to come by in these lands as of late...
98246-complete.title: Trying Times

98246-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-progress.text: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.
98246-progress.title: Trying Times

98283-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
98283-accept.text:
The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.

I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.

It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.

Carnage will come. Bring me its head.
98283-accept.title: Carnage

98293-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98293-complete.text:
Well done! Very well done!

We can definitely put these to use in replenishing our men. Half of these are from our own soldiers to begin with.

Fewer weapons in the hands of the enemy and more in ours is my kind of math, $c.
98293-complete.title: Forced Disarmament

98372-complete.name: Night Watch Guard
98372-complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
98372-complete.title: An Unfortunate End

98824-complete.name: High Explorer Magellas
98824-complete.text:
What's this you've got...

Woah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.

You've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.

We'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.
98824-complete.title: Prehistoric Prism

98824-progress.name: High Explorer Magellas
98824-progress.text: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.
98824-progress.title: Prehistoric Prism
